@SharkTankGlobal 's @kevinoleary reveals the truth about wealth, business, investing, saving, marriage, Steve Jobs, Elon Musk and getting rich! Kevin O'leary from Shark Tank!

He explains: 
How to 10X your income without working harder. 
The biggest lie about investing and what actually works. 
The harsh truth about becoming rich. 
The $28 habit that is keeping you poor.  
The wealth rule that took Kevin from $100 to $100,000.
